description: This file contains the implementation of the ODBTP driver for the ADOdb PHP database abstraction layer. It includes the class 'ADODB_odbtp' with methods for database connection, query execution, transaction management, sequence handling, and driver-specific configurations. Additionally, it defines several specialized recordset classes for different database types such as MSSQL, Access, VFP, OCI8, and Sybase.

classes.name: ADODB_odbtp
classes.description: Main driver class for ODBTP database connectivity, providing methods for connection, query execution, transaction handling, sequence management, and driver configuration tailored for ODBTP.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_odbtp
classes.description: Base recordset class for handling query results from the ODBTP driver, supporting various fetch modes and navigation methods.

classes.name: ADODB_odbtp_mssql
classes.description: Specialized recordset class for MSSQL database interactions via ODBTP.

classes.name: ADODB_odbtp_access
classes.description: Specialized recordset class for MS Access database interactions via ODBTP.

classes.name: ADODB_odbtp_vfp
classes.description: Specialized recordset class for Visual FoxPro database interactions via ODBTP.

classes.name: ADODB_odbtp_oci8
classes.description: Specialized recordset class for Oracle OCI8 database interactions via ODBTP.

classes.name: ADODB_odbtp_sybase
classes.description: Specialized recordset class for Sybase database interactions via ODBTP.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Returns an array containing the server's description and version, fetched via ODBTP attributes.

methods.name: ErrorMsg
methods.description: Retrieves the last error message from the ODBTP connection.

methods.name: ErrorNo
methods.description: Retrieves the last error code/state from the ODBTP connection.

methods.name: _insertID
methods.description: Generates the last inserted ID for auto-increment or sequence-based primary keys.

methods.name: _affectedrows
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last executed query.

methods.name: CreateSequence
methods.description: Creates a new sequence in the database, initializing its value.

methods.name: DropSequence
methods.description: Drops an existing sequence from the database.

methods.name: GenID
methods.description: Generates a new unique sequence value, creating the sequence if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the database using ODBTP driver with driver-specific configurations.

methods.name: _pconnect
methods.description: Establishes a persistent connection to the database.

methods.name: SelectDB
methods.description: Selects the target database schema.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about database tables.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about table columns.

methods.name: MetaPrimaryKeys
methods.description: Retrieves primary key columns for a specified table.

methods.name: metaForeignKeys
methods.description: Retrieves foreign key constraints for a specified table.

methods.name: BeginTrans
methods.description: Begins a new transaction.

methods.name: CommitTrans
methods.description: Commits the current transaction.

methods.name: RollbackTrans
methods.description: Rolls back the current transaction.

methods.name: SelectLimit
methods.description: Executes a query with limit and offset support, adjusting for driver specifics.

methods.name: Prepare
methods.description: Prepares an SQL statement for execution, supporting input parameter binding.

methods.name: PrepareSP
methods.description: Prepares a stored procedure call for execution.

methods.name: Parameter
methods.description: Binds PHP variables as parameters to prepared statements or stored procedures.

methods.name: UpdateBlob
methods.description: Updates a BLOB field in a table, first inserting a null blob then replacing it.

methods.name: MetaIndexes
methods.description: Retrieves index information for a table, supports specific database types like MSSQL.

methods.name: MetaIndexes_mssql
methods.description: Retrieves index details specifically for MSSQL databases.

methods.name: IfNull
methods.description: Generates SQL for null handling specific to different ODBC drivers.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Executes an SQL query or prepared statement with optional input parameters.

methods.name: _close
methods.description: Closes the database connection and cleans up resources.
